reason: The named independent lab and a batch report that matches the number on the box is exactly what I look for, and 200 mg of bisglycinate with no oxide is a real dose. At $24.99 for the first box I would try one and see how I sleep.
objection: Thirty foil sachets a month is more packaging waste, and it is a brand with no reviews yet, so I would open the lab report before I trust it.
would_change_my_mind: If the batch report on the page did not match the batch number on the box, or the lab was not a real, checkable one, I would pass.
